description: Modoc – Yesterday, lightning storms ignited fires across Assembly District 1. 19 fires are burning in Klamath National Forest alone, with the Head Fire being the largest. As of yesterday evening, the fire was at 3,000 to 4,000 acres and causing evacuations. There are also 8 fires burning in the Shasta Trinity National Forest, 11 in the Happy Camp/Oak Knoll Ranger Districts, and 23 in the Six Rivers National Forest.
